entries.6589390a0477a281: The core of revenue is materials for packaging and printing. External-customer revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥91,751 million for the Packaging-Related Business, ¥90,060 million for the Polymer and Coating-Related Business, ¥82,062 million for the Colorant and Functional Materials-Related Business and ¥80,974 million for the Printing and Information-Related Business, with the four businesses closely matched. By region, Japan accounts for ¥157,313 million, and overseas sales, including to China, make up more than half.
entries.6ff0263953635ba5: It is pursuing the management plan ‘artience2027/2030 “GROWTH”,’ with 2030 as its goal. For the 3 years from 2024 (artience2027), its 3 basic policies are transformation into a group of high-earning existing businesses, creation of a group of strategic key businesses, and transformation of the management foundation. It states that it will concentrate group resources on 2 areas: the mobility and battery field, including lithium-ion battery materials, and the display and advanced electronics field, including color resists for liquid crystal displays, optical pressure-sensitive adhesives and semiconductor-related materials.
entries.708ad41922d9a5fc: It aims to create value that resonates with people’s sensibilities by fusing and refining ‘art’ (stimulation of the senses and mind, such as color) and ‘science’ (technology, materials and rationality).
